title_en: Chinese History (14/20): The Factory Years of Reform and Opening Up
note_en: 从…转向… describes a shift from one state to another: 经济发展逐渐从计划经济转向市场经济 "the economy gradually shifted from a planned economy to a market economy." Unlike English, the whole "from" phrase comes before the verb, and no separate word for "to" is needed, because 转向 itself means "turn toward." Compare 从…到… (from... to...), which marks a range rather than a change of direction.
